intro.title: Fresh Starts, a podcast about big changes
intro.context: Ellie lived in London. Three years ago, she moved to a small village in Scotland, near the city of Inverness.
intro.predict: What could be difficult about moving from a big city to a small village?
ideas: nothing to do in the evenings
intro.picture: Map of the UK with London and Inverness marked, or a licence-free photo of a quiet Scottish village. No photos of real people.
